har-pg-1: Jalen 'Jet' Reyes leaves defenders with nothing but a breeze and a confused look. Great pick if you like fast breaks.
har-sg-7: Tommy 'Splash' Okafor shoots from so far out the cheerleaders need binoculars. Hot nights are very hot.
har-sf-11: Andre 'The Viking' Lindqvist plays like he is rowing toward the rim. Loud, tough, and always on the glass.
har-pf-21: Marcus 'Doorbell' Bell rings the rim and the crowd answers. Rebounds and putbacks are his love language.
har-c-34: Moses 'Big Mo' Adeyemi is a gentle giant in the paint. Blocks shots and then politely asks for the ball.
har-pg-5: Danny 'Dime' Cho sees passes nobody else knows exist. Assists are the main course here.
har-sf-23: Luis 'Lefty' Navarro does everything with the left hand and the defense never gets used to it. Sneaky good.
har-c-44: Grant 'The Wall' Whitfield sets screens that rearrange the furniture. Few shots, big presence.
sum-pg-2: Kai 'Quick Kai' Thompson crosses the court before the echo of the whistle fades. Steals are his side hustle.
sum-sg-10: Rafael 'Rafa' Duarte glides into the lane like he owns the building. Smooth, stylish, and a little bit showy.
sum-sf-14: Owen 'Ice' Mercer never sweats the final minute. Cool hands, clutch buckets, zero panic.
sum-pf-32: DeShawn 'Pike' Pike is long, sharp, and always poking at loose balls. Hustle plays with a point.
sum-c-50: Viktor 'Tower' Halvorsen blocks out the sky and most of the scoreboard. Rebound machine with a quiet smile.
sum-sg-4: Eli 'Bucket' Brooks gets a basket whenever the team needs one. Confident, creative, and fun to watch.
sum-pf-15: Nate 'Hustle' Kimura dives on every loose ball, even the ones in the other gym. Energy for days.
sum-sf-8: Caleb 'Frosty' Frost starts the night chilly and finishes on fire. Slow burn, big finish.
riv-qb-12: Colt 'Slingshot' Mason winds up like a catapult and lets it fly. Big arm, big grin, and an occasional adventurous throw.
riv-rb-28: Terrell 'Freight' Banks runs like a train with a tight schedule. Hard to stop once he gets going downhill.
riv-rb-34: Jesse 'Sparky' Ortiz is the spark off the bench. Quick cuts, short bursts, and a lot of noise from the crowd.
riv-wr-81: Darius 'Velcro' Cole catches everything thrown near him. Safe hands, steady yards, rarely a drop.
riv-wr-85: Andre 'Flash' Fontaine is gone before the defender blinks. Deep shots are his specialty.
riv-wr-17: Mateo 'Gadget' Silva shows up on sweeps, screens, and trick plays. You never know which way he is headed.
riv-te-88: Ben 'Moose' Hartley is a big target near the goal line. Blocks like a wall and catches like a golden retriever.
riv-k-3: Ian 'Boots' Park kicks the Otters out of trouble. Steady from the middle range, small but vital points.
irn-qb-9: Jack 'Hammer' Calloway drives the ball hard into tight windows. Confident, loud, and fun to cheer for.
irn-rb-22: Reggie 'Plow' Dunn clears a path through the middle by himself. Short yardage is his comfort zone.
irn-rb-30: Cam 'Zig' Ellis zigzags through traffic like it is a video game. Small moves, big gains.
irn-wr-80: Malik 'Sky' Foster plays above the rim of the helmets. Jump balls and deep routes are his thing.
irn-wr-84: Tobias 'Glue' Grant makes contested catches stick. Third down is his favorite down.
irn-wr-11: Nico 'Wildcat' Vega sprints, spins, and pounces. A bit wild, a lot of fun.
irn-te-87: Walt 'Anvil' Briggs is heavy, steady, and hard to move. Red zone targets are his specialty.
irn-k-6: Oleg 'Laser' Novak sends the ball straight through the uprights. Cool under pressure, even late in the game.
